Academic Platforms

Education that Fits Your Lifestyle

Adult Education
Free Career Development and College Preparation (CDCP) courses for adults. Earn certificates and prepare for college.
Career Education
Certificate and degree programs designed to get students working in various technical fields.
Distance Learning
Get more flexibility for your busy schedule with online classes.
Early College and Dual Enrollment
High school students can attend college while still in high school, earning degrees, certificates, or getting a head start on college.
Levan Institute for Lifelong Learning
Interesting and useful learning experiences available primarily to those 55 and over interested in continuing to gain knowledge. Courses offered at Panorama Campus, Online, and throughout the Community.
